newsitem.title: UK: BTG says to raise 25 mln stg for expansion.
newsitem.headline: BTG says to raise 25 mln stg for expansion.

text.p: British technology group BTG Plc said on Thursday it was placing 4.3 million new shares with institutional investors to raise 25 million stg to expand its business.
The group also reported a pre-tax loss of 2.73 million stg in the year to March 31, compared with a loss of 2.74 million the year before. Turnover climbed to 22.46 million stg from 20.75 million.
"We have the opportunity to consolidate our position as a world leader in the growing technology transfer market," said chief executive Ian Harvey.
"These results show that we are making progress towards this goal and today's placing gives us the resources to translate this ambition into reality".
The placing would be through Kleinwort Benson Securities.
The group said it now has major new revenue streams from recently launched products in the biosciences division and "strong underlying growth overall".
There was "encouraging" progress in the technology pipeline with 97 new inventions accepted compared with 90 a year ago.
"We are seeing significant growth in the number of opportunities for BTG," Harvey added.
"We believe BTG is well placed to take advantage of these opportunities and are confident of further progress."
